purpose: Context KB for pain.001.001.09 CustomerCreditTransferInitiation auto-fixing. For each XML tag: datatype, mandatory flag, possible errors, affected tags, and all possible fixes.

iso_20022_rules.NbOfTxsRule: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the total number of CdtTrfTxInf occurrences across all PmtInf blocks.
iso_20022_rules.CtrlSumRule: If CtrlSum is present (at GrpHdr or PmtInf level), it must equal the arithmetic sum of all InstdAmt values in the corresponding scope.
iso_20022_rules.PaymentMethodRule: PmtInf/PmtMtd for a credit transfer initiation must be 'TRF' (transfer); 'TRA' and 'CHK' are not used for CBPR+ credit transfers.
iso_20022_rules.RequestedExecutionDateRule: PmtInf/ReqdExctnDt is a choice between Dt (ISODate) and DtTm (ISODateTime); exactly one of the two must be present.
iso_20022_rules.AmountChoiceRule: CdtTrfTxInf/Amt is a choice between InstdAmt (ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount) and EqvtAmt; exactly one must be present.
iso_20022_rules.DebtorAgentRule: PmtInf/DbtrAgt must identify the debtor's agent by BICFI (FinInstnId/BICFI) or by ClrSysMmbId; a financial institution identification is mandatory.
iso_20022_rules.InitiatingPartyRule: GrpHdr/InitgPty must be present and must carry at least a Name (Nm) or an organisation/private identification.
iso_20022_rules.AccountIdentificationRule: Account identification (DbtrAcct/Id, CdtrAcct/Id) is a choice between IBAN and Othr; exactly one must be present per account.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules: AppHdr (BusinessApplicationHeaderV02) is mandatory and must precede the Document.
AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'pain.001.001.09' and match the Document xmlns namespace identifier.
AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.02' for the CBPR+ customer credit transfer initiation service.
All DateTime fields (AppHdr/CreDt, GrpHdr/CreDtTm, ReqdExctnDt/DtTm) must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM format; the 'Z' suffix and milliseconds are forbidden.
GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the count of CdtTrfTxInf across every PmtInf block.
When CtrlSum is present it must equal the sum of all InstdAmt amounts in its scope.
When PmtTpInf/SvcLvl/Cd = 'SEPA', the InstdAmt currency (Ccy) must be 'EUR' and the debtor/creditor accounts must be IBANs.
All text/code fields are limited to the SWIFT FIN-X character set; Nm/Adr/RmtInf are extended with !#$&%*=^_{|}~\";<>@[\] (encode < as < and > as >).
PstlAdr, when present, must contain a Ctry (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code).
BICFI values must follow ISO 9362: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters.
IBAN values must follow ISO 13616 format and pass the MOD-97 check-digit validation.

tags.description: Business Application Header V02. Mandatory for all CBPR+ messages and must precede the Document element.

errors.description: AppHdr element is absent; CBPR+ mandates BusinessApplicationHeaderV02.
possible_fixes: Insert a complete <AppHdr> block before the <Document> element.
Ensure AppHdr contains Fr, To, BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc, and CreDt.

tags.description: Sending MessagingEndpoint. Must contain a BIC8 or BIC11 in FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI when exchanged on SWIFT.

errors.description: Fr element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <Fr><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{sender_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></Fr> inside AppHdr.
Harvest the BICFI value from PmtInf/DbtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI when available.

errors.description: AppHdr/Fr contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters per ISO 9362.
Example valid BIC: DEUTDEFFXXX

tags.description: Receiving MessagingEndpoint. Must contain a BIC8 or BIC11 in FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI on SWIFT.

errors.description: To element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <To><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{receiver_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></To> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/To contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters per ISO 9362.

tags.description: Unique identifier of the Business Message. Must equal Document/CstmrCdtTrfInitn/GrpHdr/MsgId.

errors.description: BizMsgIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Copy the value of GrpHdr/MsgId and insert as <BizMsgIdr>{MsgId_value}</BizMsgIdr>.
If MsgId is also absent, generate a unique Max35Text value (e.g. MSG-YYYYMMDD-001).

errors.description: AppHdr/BizMsgIdr does not equal Document/CstmrCdtTrfInitn/GrpHdr/MsgId.
possible_fixes: Read GrpHdr/MsgId and set BizMsgIdr to the same value.
If BizMsgIdr is the source of truth, update GrpHdr/MsgId to match BizMsgIdr.
Never invent a new value — always harvest from the other field.

errors.description: BizMsgIdr exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate the value to a maximum of 35 characters.
Synchronize the truncated value back to GrpHdr/MsgId.

tags.description: Message Definition Identifier. Must exactly match the Document namespace identifier 'pain.001.001.09'.

errors.description: MsgDefIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <MsgDefIdr>pain.001.001.09</MsgDefIdr> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr does not match the Document xmlns namespace identifier.
possible_fixes: Read the xmlns attribute from the Document root element (urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.001.001.09).
Set MsgDefIdr to 'pain.001.001.09'.
Ensure no trailing spaces or version mismatches.

tags.description: Business Service identifier. Must be 'swift.cbprplus.02' for the CBPR+ customer credit transfer initiation service.

errors.description: BizSvc is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <BizSvc>swift.cbprplus.02</BizSvc> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: BizSvc contains a value other than the expected CBPR+ service name.
possible_fixes: Replace value with 'swift.cbprplus.02'.

tags.description: Creation date/time of the Business Message. Must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM format; the 'Z' suffix and milliseconds are forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDt>{current datetime in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 format}</CreDt> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt uses the 'Z' suffix which is forbidden under CBPR+.
AppHdr/CreDt has no timezone offset; CBPR+ requires an explicit +HH:MM offset.

tags.description: Unique message identifier assigned by the initiating party. Must equal AppHdr/BizMsgIdr. No leading/trailing spaces.

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgId is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <MsgId>{unique identifier up to 35 chars}</MsgId> as the first child of GrpHdr.
Use format MSG-YYYYMMDD-NNN (e.g. MSG-20260601-001).
Ensure the same value is in AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to a maximum of 35 characters preserving a meaningful prefix.
Synchronize the truncated value to AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.

errors.description: MsgId contains characters outside the FIN-X character set or contains spaces.
possible_fixes: Remove spaces and replace special/accented characters with ASCII equivalents.
Allowed: A-Z a-z 0-9 / - ? : ( ) . , ' + (no leading or trailing spaces).

tags.description: Creation date and time of the message. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. The 'Z' suffix and milliseconds are forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: GrpHdr/CreDtTm is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDtTm>{current datetime as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00}</CreDtTm>.

errors.description: CreDtTm uses the 'Z' suffix; forbidden under CBPR+.
CreDtTm has no timezone offset; CBPR+ requires an explicit +HH:MM offset.

tags.description: Number of individual transactions. Must equal the total count of CdtTrfTxInf blocks across all PmtInf blocks.

errors.description: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs is absent.
possible_fixes: Count all CdtTrfTxInf blocks across every PmtInf and insert <NbOfTxs>{count}</NbOfTxs>.

errors.description: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs does not equal the actual count of CdtTrfTxInf blocks across all PmtInf.
possible_fixes: Count every CdtTrfTxInf element in all PmtInf blocks and set NbOfTxs to that count.

errors.description: NbOfTxs contains non-numeric characters.
possible_fixes: Replace with a numeric integer string (max 15 digits). Example: '1'.

tags.description: Control sum. If present, must equal the arithmetic sum of all InstdAmt values across all CdtTrfTxInf blocks.

errors.description: GrpHdr/CtrlSum does not equal the sum of all InstdAmt values.
possible_fixes: Sum all InstdAmt values and set CtrlSum to the result.
Remove CtrlSum if it is not required, to avoid a mismatch error.

errors.description: CtrlSum contains a non-numeric or invalid decimal value.
possible_fixes: Use a valid decimal number format (e.g. 1000.00).
Maximum 18 digits total with up to 5 fraction digits.

tags.description: Initiating party. The party initiating the payment. Must carry at least a Name (Nm) or an organisation/private identification.

errors.description: GrpHdr/InitgPty block is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <InitgPty><Nm>{initiating party name, max 140 chars}</Nm></InitgPty> inside GrpHdr.

tags.description: Name of the initiating party. CBPR+ requires the initiating party to be identified; Nm is the primary identifier when no structured Id is supplied.

errors.description: InitgPty has neither Nm nor Id; the initiating party is not identifiable.
possible_fixes: Insert <Nm>{initiating party name}</Nm> inside InitgPty.
Alternatively provide InitgPty/Id with OrgId or PrvtId.

errors.description: InitgPty/Nm exceeds 140 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate the name to a maximum of 140 characters.

tags.description: Unique identification of the payment information block, assigned by the initiating party.

errors.description: PmtInf/PmtInfId is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <PmtInfId>{unique reference, max 35 chars}</PmtInfId> as the first child of PmtInf.
Example: PMT-20260601-001

errors.description: PmtInfId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to a maximum of 35 characters preserving the unique prefix.

tags.description: Payment method. For CBPR+ credit transfer initiation this must be 'TRF' (transfer).

errors.description: PmtInf/PmtMtd is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <PmtMtd>TRF</PmtMtd> inside PmtInf.

errors.description: PmtMtd contains a value that is not 'TRF' for a credit transfer initiation.
possible_fixes: Replace value with 'TRF'.
TRA and CHK are not applicable to CBPR+ customer credit transfers.

tags.description: Requested Execution Date — the date on which the initiating party requests the clearing agent to process the credit transfer. Must not be in the past.

errors.description: PmtInf is missing the mandatory <ReqdExctnDt>.
possible_fixes: Add <ReqdExctnDt><Dt>YYYY-MM-DD</Dt></ReqdExctnDt> inside each <PmtInf>.
Use today's date or a future business date.

errors.description: ReqdExctnDt is in the past.
possible_fixes: Replace with today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a future execution date.

tags.description: Batch booking indicator. If true, a single debit entry is requested for the sum of all transactions; if false, individual entries are requested.

errors.description: BtchBookg contains a value that is not a valid boolean.
possible_fixes: Replace with 'true' or 'false' (lowercase).
Remove the element if batch booking is not specified.

tags.description: Number of transactions within this PmtInf block. If present, must equal the count of CdtTrfTxInf in this PmtInf.

errors.description: PmtInf/NbOfTxs does not equal the count of CdtTrfTxInf within this PmtInf block.
possible_fixes: Count the CdtTrfTxInf blocks in this PmtInf and set NbOfTxs to that count.
Remove PmtInf/NbOfTxs if not required.

tags.description: Control sum within this PmtInf block. If present, must equal the sum of InstdAmt across the CdtTrfTxInf in this PmtInf.

errors.description: PmtInf/CtrlSum does not equal the sum of InstdAmt within this PmtInf block.
possible_fixes: Sum the InstdAmt values within this PmtInf and set CtrlSum to the result.
Remove PmtInf/CtrlSum if not required.

tags.description: Service level code from the External Service Level code list. 'SEPA' indicates a SEPA credit transfer and forces EUR currency and IBAN accounts.

errors.description: SvcLvl/Cd contains a value not in the External Service Level code list.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid External Service Level code (e.g. SEPA, URGP, NURG).
Use Prtry under SvcLvl instead of Cd for proprietary service levels.

errors.description: SvcLvl/Cd = 'SEPA' but the InstdAmt currency is not EUR.
possible_fixes: Set the InstdAmt Ccy attribute to 'EUR' for SEPA service level.
Alternatively change the service level if the currency is not EUR.

tags.description: Category purpose code from the External Category Purpose code list. Specifies the high-level purpose of the payment for processing routing.

errors.description: CtgyPurp/Cd contains a value not in the External Category Purpose code list.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid External Category Purpose code (e.g. SALA, SUPP, TAXS).
Use Prtry under CtgyPurp for proprietary category purposes.

tags.description: Requested execution date (date-only form). Choice with DtTm; exactly one must be present. Format YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or a future business day.

errors.description: ReqdExctnDt is absent; neither Dt nor DtTm is present.
possible_fixes: Insert <ReqdExctnDt><Dt>{YYYY-MM-DD}</Dt></ReqdExctnDt> inside PmtInf.
Use today's date or the next valid business day.

errors.description: ReqdExctnDt/Dt is in the past.
possible_fixes: Replace with today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) or the next valid business day.
Use date-only format with no time component or offset.

errors.description: ReqdExctnDt/Dt is not in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. includes time or slashes).
possible_fixes: Use date-only format YYYY-MM-DD with no time component.

tags.description: Requested execution date/time (date-time form). Choice with Dt; exactly one must be present. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; 'Z' suffix forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: ReqdExctnDt/DtTm uses the 'Z' suffix; forbidden under CBPR+.
ReqdExctnDt/DtTm has no timezone offset.

tags.description: Name of the debtor (the party owing the money / paying customer). Mandatory under CBPR+ for the ordering customer.

errors.description: PmtInf/Dbtr is absent or has no Nm; the debtor is not identifiable.
possible_fixes: Insert <Dbtr><Nm>{debtor name, max 140 chars}</Nm></Dbtr> inside PmtInf.

errors.description: PmtInf/Dbtr/Nm exceeds 140 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate the debtor name to a maximum of 140 characters.

errors.description: PmtInf/Dbtr/Nm contains characters outside the permitted (extended) character set.
possible_fixes: Nm fields support the extended charset: A-Z a-z 0-9 / - ? : ( ) . , ' + SPACE and !#$&%*=^_{|}~\";<>@[\].
Replace < with < and > with >.

tags.description: Country of the debtor's postal address. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Mandatory within PstlAdr when PstlAdr is present.

errors.description: PmtInf/Dbtr/PstlAdr is present but Ctry is missing.
possible_fixes: Add <Ctry>{ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code}</Ctry> inside PstlAdr.
Example: <Ctry>GB</Ctry>

tags.description: Debtor account IBAN. DbtrAcct is mandatory; account Id is a choice between IBAN and Othr. IBAN follows ISO 13616 and MOD-97.

errors.description: PmtInf/DbtrAcct is absent; the debtor account is mandatory.
possible_fixes: Insert <DbtrAcct><Id><IBAN>{debtor_iban}</IBAN></Id></DbtrAcct> inside PmtInf.
If no IBAN, use <DbtrAcct><Id><Othr><Id>{account_number}</Id></Othr></Id></DbtrAcct>.

errors.description: DbtrAcct/Id/IBAN fails ISO 13616 format or the MOD-97 checksum.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid IBAN: 2-letter country code + 2 check digits + BBAN (max 34 chars).
Verify the MOD-97 check-digit computation.

tags.description: BIC of the debtor agent (the debtor's bank). DbtrAgt is mandatory; identified by BICFI or ClrSysMmbId.

errors.description: PmtInf/DbtrAgt is absent; the debtor agent is mandatory.
possible_fixes: Insert <DbtrAgt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{debtor_bank_bic}</BICFI></FinInstnId></DbtrAgt> inside PmtInf.

errors.description: DbtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters per ISO 9362.

tags.description: Charge bearer specifying who bears the transaction charges. SLEV = following service level.

errors.description: ChrgBr contains an invalid code.
possible_fixes: Replace with one of: DEBT, CRED, SHAR.
Use SHAR (SLEV disallowed by policy).

tags.description: Instruction identification assigned by the initiating party for the individual transaction. Optional, max 16 characters (CBPR+ RestrictedFINXMax16Text).

errors.description: PmtId/InstrId exceeds 16 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to a maximum of 16 characters.
Remove InstrId if it is not required.

tags.description: End-to-end identification assigned by the initiating party. Must be passed through the chain unchanged. 'NOTPROVIDED' is allowed.

errors.description: EndToEndId is absent from PmtId.
possible_fixes: Insert <EndToEndId>NOTPROVIDED</EndToEndId> if the value is unknown.
Otherwise insert <EndToEndId>{originator's end-to-end reference, max 35 chars}</EndToEndId>.

errors.description: EndToEndId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 35 characters maximum.
Use 'NOTPROVIDED' if the original reference cannot be preserved within the length limit.

tags.description: Instructed amount with currency attribute (Ccy). Amt is a choice between InstdAmt and EqvtAmt; exactly one must be present. Amount must be greater than zero. ISO 4217 currency code.

errors.description: CdtTrfTxInf/Amt is absent or neither InstdAmt nor EqvtAmt is present.
possible_fixes: Insert <Amt><InstdAmt Ccy="{ISO4217}">{amount}</InstdAmt></Amt> inside CdtTrfTxInf.
Ensure the Ccy attribute is a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 code (e.g. EUR, USD, GBP).

errors.description: InstdAmt is present but the Ccy attribute is missing or not a valid ISO 4217 code.
possible_fixes: Add a Ccy attribute with a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code.
Example: <InstdAmt Ccy="EUR">{amount}</InstdAmt>

errors.description: InstdAmt amount is zero or negative.
possible_fixes: Replace with a positive decimal amount greater than zero.
Maximum: 18 digits total, 5 fraction digits.

tags.description: BIC of the creditor agent (the creditor's bank). Optional; identified by BICFI or ClrSysMmbId when present.

errors.description: CdtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters per ISO 9362.

tags.description: Name of the creditor (beneficiary). Mandatory under CBPR+ for the beneficiary customer.

errors.description: CdtTrfTxInf/Cdtr is absent or has no Nm; the creditor is not identifiable.
possible_fixes: Insert <Cdtr><Nm>{creditor name, max 140 chars}</Nm></Cdtr> inside CdtTrfTxInf.

errors.description: CdtTrfTxInf/Cdtr/Nm exceeds 140 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate the creditor name to a maximum of 140 characters.

tags.description: Country of the creditor's postal address. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Mandatory within PstlAdr when PstlAdr is present.

errors.description: CdtTrfTxInf/Cdtr/PstlAdr is present but Ctry is missing.
possible_fixes: Add <Ctry>{ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code}</Ctry> inside Cdtr/PstlAdr.
Example: <Ctry>FR</Ctry>

tags.description: Creditor account IBAN. CdtrAcct is optional; account Id is a choice between IBAN and Othr. IBAN follows ISO 13616 and MOD-97.

errors.description: CdtrAcct/Id/IBAN fails ISO 13616 format or the MOD-97 checksum.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid IBAN: 2-letter country code + 2 check digits + BBAN (max 34 chars).
Verify the MOD-97 check-digit computation.

tags.description: Unstructured remittance information. RmtInf is a choice between Ustrd and Strd. Each Ustrd occurrence is limited to 140 characters.

errors.description: RmtInf/Ustrd exceeds 140 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate the Ustrd value to a maximum of 140 characters.
Note: CBPR+ permits only a single Ustrd occurrence.

errors.description: RmtInf/Ustrd contains characters outside the permitted (extended) character set.
possible_fixes: RmtInf fields support the extended charset; replace < with < and > with >.
Remove characters not permitted by the SWIFT extended character set.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest GrpHdr/MsgId and set BizMsgIdr to the same value (or vice versa).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'pain.001.001.09' and match the Document xmlns namespace.
GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the count of CdtTrfTxInf across all PmtInf blocks.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Count every CdtTrfTxInf in all PmtInf and set NbOfTxs to that count.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/CtrlSum must equal the sum of all InstdAmt values when present.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Sum all InstdAmt values and set CtrlSum to the result, or remove CtrlSum.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: PmtInf/NbOfTxs must equal the count of CdtTrfTxInf within its PmtInf block when present.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Count CdtTrfTxInf within the PmtInf and set PmtInf/NbOfTxs accordingly.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: PmtInf/CtrlSum must equal the sum of InstdAmt within its PmtInf block when present.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Sum InstdAmt within the PmtInf and set PmtInf/CtrlSum accordingly.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: PmtInf/PmtMtd must be 'TRF' for a credit transfer initiation.
ReqdExctnDt is a choice: exactly one of Dt or DtTm must be present.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Keep exactly one of Dt or DtTm; remove the other.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: CdtTrfTxInf/Amt is a choice: exactly one of InstdAmt or EqvtAmt must be present.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Keep exactly one of InstdAmt or EqvtAmt; remove the other.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: When PmtTpInf/SvcLvl/Cd = 'SEPA', InstdAmt Ccy must be 'EUR' and accounts must be IBANs.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set InstdAmt Ccy to EUR and ensure debtor/creditor accounts use IBAN when SvcLvl=SEPA.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: PstlAdr, when present, must contain a Ctry element.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add a Ctry (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) element inside any PstlAdr that lacks one.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Account Id is a choice: exactly one of IBAN or Othr must be present per account.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Keep exactly one of IBAN or Othr per account; remove the other.

schema_mapping_notes.root_element: pain.001.001.09 root is /Document/CstmrCdtTrfInitn (CustomerCreditTransferInitiation); the AppHdr (BAH) precedes the Document.
schema_mapping_notes.msg_def_idr: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must be 'pain.001.001.09' matching the namespace urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.001.001.09.
schema_mapping_notes.biz_svc: AppHdr/BizSvc for the CBPR+ customer credit transfer initiation service is 'swift.cbprplus.02'.
schema_mapping_notes.structure: pain.001 has two repeating levels: PmtInf [1..n] (payment-information/batch level carrying Dbtr, DbtrAcct, DbtrAgt, PmtMtd, ReqdExctnDt) and, nested within each PmtInf, CdtTrfTxInf [1..n] (the individual credit transfers carrying PmtId, Amt, Cdtr, CdtrAcct).
schema_mapping_notes.amount_location: Unlike pacs.008/pacs.009 where the amount is IntrBkSttlmAmt directly under CdtTrfTxInf, pain.001 wraps the amount in an Amt container as a choice of InstdAmt or EqvtAmt.
schema_mapping_notes.debtor_at_pmtinf: In pain.001 the Dbtr, DbtrAcct and DbtrAgt are defined once at PmtInf level and apply to every CdtTrfTxInf in that block, whereas the Cdtr, CdtrAcct and CdtrAgt are per-transaction under CdtTrfTxInf.
schema_mapping_notes.datetime_format: All ISODateTime fields (AppHdr/CreDt, GrpHdr/CreDtTm, ReqdExctnDt/DtTm) must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; the 'Z' suffix and milliseconds are forbidden under CBPR+.
schema_mapping_notes.nb_of_txs_scope: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs counts CdtTrfTxInf across ALL PmtInf blocks, while the optional PmtInf/NbOfTxs counts only within a single PmtInf block.
